names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Αυγούστου, «Άγιος Σόλεβ ο Αιγύπτιος», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 5 августа ст. ст.; the line declines the name and the link's nominative closes with a rank, which is not stored in the form. The nominative is «Сивел Египетский, мч.», and the Russian spells with С and в what the Greek spells Σόλεβ.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 августа ст. ст. — «Мчч. Кантидия , Кантидиана и Сивела , в Египте (IV).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Σόλεβ ο Αιγύπτιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole of its prose is one sentence, «Ο Άγιος Σόλεβ ο Αιγύπτιος μαρτύρησε δια τοξευόμενου βέλους», and above it stands a couplet playing on his name read backwards. There is no year and no place beyond Egypt, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations` object. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no apolytikion and no kontakion, so this folder takes no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).

death.note: The folder held no date of any kind, saint.gr giving it a bare line. days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line of the three «(IV)», and that interval is the whole of what it gives them.
